players.product: Precision fluid dispensing systems (underfill / encapsulant) and X-ray / optical test and inspection systems for semiconductor packaging (Advanced Technology Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: Advanced Technology Solutions sales for fiscal 2025 (year ended October 31, 2025) were $624,510 thousand, up 4.9% (organic +4.1%) from $595,557 thousand, driven by robust growth in electronics dispense product lines and electronic processing and optical sensors, partially offset by weakness in x-ray inspection systems; ATS segment EBITDA was $146,589 thousand (23.5% of sales versus 21.7%), up 180 basis points on strong incrementals and lower selling and administrative expenses.
quarterly_data.figure: ATS fiscal 2025 sales $624,510 thousand (+4.9%); EBITDA $146,589 thousand (23.5%)
